documents.title: Approved Cedar Systems product information
documents.text: Cedar Systems provides workflow coordination and account reporting. A discovery meeting can establish integration requirements. No price, deployment timeline, uptime guarantee or specific vendor connector is approved here.

documents.title: Customer inquiry and call evidence
documents.text: Our consulting operations team struggles with unclear ownership. We want workflow coordination and account reporting. Please arrange a discovery meeting to understand our requirements. No budget has been approved.

raw_proposal.assessment: The customer's consulting operations team is struggling with 'unclear ownership' and seeks 'workflow coordination and account reporting.' They have requested a discovery meeting to clarify their requirements but have not yet approved a budget. The account is currently in the 'qualified' stage with verified consent and ownership by 'cedar-east.'

claims.quote: Our consulting operations team struggles with unclear ownership.
We want workflow coordination and account reporting.
Please arrange a discovery meeting to understand our requirements.

raw_proposal.draft: Thank you for reaching out. We understand that your consulting operations team is struggling with unclear ownership and that you are seeking workflow coordination and account reporting. To better align with your needs, we would like to schedule a discovery meeting to explore your specific requirements. This will help us tailor our approach to your operational goals. Please let us know a convenient time for this discussion.
questions: What specific challenges are you facing with unclear ownership in your consulting operations?
Are there any existing tools or systems currently in use that you would like to integrate with Cedar Systems?
What are your expectations for the workflow coordination and account reporting features?
uncertainties: The customer has not yet approved a budget, which may impact the timeline or scope of the project.
